documents.title: Media Delivery: Video Capabilities and Operation Points

workItems.name: Video Operating Points - Harmonization and Stereo MV-HEVC

scope.text: Video codecs, encoders, and decoders are core components of 3GPP services. At the same time, video encoders and decoders, residing on 3GPP User Equipment (UE) and defined in 3GPP specifications, also provide interoperability points for third-party services. Video capabilities are predominantly independent of the service in use. This specification addresses the definition of video capabilities and Operation Points such that 3GPP service specifications as well as third-party service providers can refer to the interoperability points defined in this specification.
scope.firstSentence: Video codecs, encoders, and decoders are core components of 3GPP services.

notes: A release with no issue of a document leaves the issue of the earlier release in force.
